name: @utir/ssc-mcp
description: MCP stdio server for Small Software Cloud — lets AI agents deploy and manage apps

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --external:@modelcontextprotocol/server --external:zod --external:axios --external:archiver --external:form-data --external:ignore --alias:@ssc/client=../client/src/index.ts --outfile=dist/index.js && chmod +x dist/index.js
